parameters.precure_definition: clip(pre_slope * cumulative_light, 0, pre_cap); inhibited branch only
parameters.r_tracking_interpretation: polymerization target -log(1-D*), not an inverse of pre-cure DoC
parameters.zero_intensity_convention: authoritative optical floor retained; no additional intensity floor
parameters.doc_history_description: MPC-side incremental R extension; algebraically reduces to the reference curing law at constant intensity. Inhibited DoC is the separate cumulative-light pre-cure signal. Time-varying R is not separately experimentally calibrated.

reference.scattering_kernel_size_formula: int(blur_size / dx) if int(blur_size / dx) % 2 != 0 else int(blur_size / dx) + 1
reference.tempo_concentration_source: AIE_TEMPOv1.1.py:300: inferred from label on active B assignment (not an executable concentration): source comment: 0mMTEMPO (26/10/01) (R^2 = 0.999); AIE_TEMPOv1.1.py:160 O2inhibition=12.6124; AIE_TEMPOv1.1.py:164 Totalinhibtion=O2inhibition; AIE_TEMPOv1.1.py:172 TEMPOinhibition=max(0.0, Totalinhibtion - O2inhibition)

historical_comparison: 4.166 used a different pre-cure slope; not a matched benchmark
